info.name: MusicBrainz Web Service v2 Areas URLs API

params.name: mbid
params.description: MusicBrainz Identifier (UUID v4) of the entity.

params.name: inc
params.description: Plus-separated list of sub-resources and relationships to include in the response.

params.name: fmt
params.description: Response serialization format. Defaults to XML; set to `json` for JSON.

items.docs: Look up a URL by MBID.

params.name: resource
params.description: A URL to look up. May be repeated up to 100 times in one request.

params.name: inc
params.description: Plus-separated list of sub-resources and relationships to include in the response.

params.name: fmt
params.description: Response serialization format. Defaults to XML; set to `json` for JSON.

items.docs: Look up one or more URLs by the resource string (up to 100 `resource` parameters per request).
